'''Health''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] works as in vanilla ''Minecraft'', except that it never regenerates on its own and the player's maximum health changes over the course of a world. Players start with 10 hearts ({{Hp|20}}), can raise this to 30 hearts with [[Crystal Heart|crystal hearts]], and lose maximum health when they [[death|die]].

== Mechanics ==
=== Maximum health ===
The pack stores each player's maximum health in a scoreboard and sets the player's <code>max_health</code> attribute from it.<ref name="set">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/heart_container/set_max_hp.mcfunction}}</ref>

{| class="wikitable"
! Value !! Health !! Notes
|-
| Starting health || {{Hp|20}} || Taken from the player's attribute when they first join.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/scoreboard/player_setup.mcfunction}}</ref>
|-
| Maximum || {{Hp|60}} || 30 hearts; crystal hearts can't be used beyond this.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/scoreboard/create_scoreboards.mcfunction}}</ref>
|-
| Floor on Easy || {{Hp|20}} || Death never lowers maximum health below 10 hearts.
|-
| Floor on Normal and Hard || {{Hp|20}} down to {{Hp|6}} || The player's ''minimum hearts'', lowered by progression. See [[Death#Minimum hearts]].
|}

* Each [[death]] lowers maximum health by 1 heart (2 on Hard).
* Each [[Crystal Heart|crystal heart]] used raises it by 1 heart.
* Staying withered for 8 seconds lowers it like a death; see [[Wither effect]].

Temporary extra health from {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} and {{EffectLink|Absorption}} works as in vanilla and isn't counted.

=== Healing ===
{{Main|Natural regeneration}}
The <code>natural_health_regeneration</code> game rule is turned off, so a full hunger bar never heals the player.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/gamerules.mcfunction}}</ref> Health has to be restored actively:
* [[Food]]: most of the pack's foods heal through {{MCW|Instant Health}} or {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} instead of restoring hunger. See [[Hunger]].
* {{ItemLink|Raw Estus}}, dropped by zombies and their variants, heals the player when picked up.
* A [[Warding Stone|warding stone]] heals players and other friends of villagers nearby.
* Some equipment, such as [[Shakudo equipment]], restores health.
* A [[Crystal Heart|crystal heart]], when used, sets health to 1 and then applies Regeneration XI for 3 seconds.

=== Hunger ===
{{Main|Hunger}}
The hunger bar is hidden and held at a level where the player can always sprint. It has no effect on health.

== Trivia ==
* The developer removed natural regeneration so that food takes over the role of potions: "You have to eat to heal and you're never given a limitation on sprinting."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=No hunger bar and no natural regeneration. You have to eat to heal and you're never given a limitation on sprinting.}}</ref>
